mission.posting: An aspiring writer wants us to get one of his scripts to a producer.

email.subject: A Convincing Application
email.body:
A writer wants to get a draft of their latest work to a producer and has had some trouble getting past secretaries and the like. He wants us to just break in and drop his work in the target's scripts to review folder so his gets looked at.
His script, "FOF_Screenply.doc" has been uploaded to the crossroads. He also provided an encrypted script that his was to compete with, that we can use to trace. This is also on the crossroads, "T2_Screenply.dec"
Upload his script to the scripts folder of the target machine. As always, remember to tab complete upload commands - "upload bin/" then press the tab key to get a list of local file to upload and autocomplete.
Good luck, -CSEC

attachments.note:
Download FOF_Screenply.doc
Trace T2_Screenplay.dec
Upload FOF_Screenply.doc to target scripts folder.
